final: WITH exam_patient AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e."aCL IgM" FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID), with_acl_data AS (SELECT ID, SEX, "aCL IgM" FROM exam_patient WHERE "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") as mean_val FROM with_acl_data), deviations AS (SELECT ep.ID, ep.SEX, ep."aCL IgM", ep."aCL IgM" - om.mean_val as deviation FROM with_acl_data ep CROSS JOIN overall_mean om), sex_avg_deviations AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) as sex_avg_dev FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), final_calc AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d."aCL IgM", d.deviation, d.deviation - sad.sex_avg_dev as above_sex_avg FROM deviations d LEFT JOIN sex_avg_deviations sad ON d.SEX = sad.SEX) SELECT ID, SEX, "aCL IgM", deviation, above_sex_avg FROM final_calc ORDER BY CASE WHEN above_sex_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, above_sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10
